goals.title: Goals that adapt

accounts.title: All accounts in one place

privacy.title: Private by design

save.title: Save on autopilot

safe.a: Yes. Aura uses 256-bit, bank-level encryption and never sells your data. Your information is yours alone.

bank.q: Does Aura work with my bank?
bank.a: At launch we support major banks, and the list grows every week. Join the waitlist and we'll tell you the moment yours is supported.

cost.a: Aura is free to start. The Plus plan is about $6/month — and waitlist members lock in 50% off for life.

launch.a: We're rolling out to the waitlist in batches. Join now to secure an early-access spot.

card.q: Do I need a credit card to join?
card.a: No. The waitlist only needs your email — nothing else.
